items.text: My paper “Education providers’ take-up of government grants: Evidence from a grant allocation discontinuity” (with Olof Rosenqvist) is now published as a working paper at [IFAU](https://www.ifau.se/Forskning/Publikationer/Working-papers/2026/education-providers-take-up-of-government-grants/) and [RF Berlin](https://www.rfberlin.com/network-paper/education-providers-take-up-of-government-grants-evidence-from-a-grant-allocation-discontinuity/). The policy report can be downloaded [here](https://jansauermann.github.io/research.html#research-reports-and-other-publications).
Together with Björn Öckert and Simon Ek, I received EUR 440,000 for my project on job search assistance providers from the Swedish Council for Health Working Life and Welfare (FORTE).

I co-organize the [9th Stockholm Uppsala Education Economics Workshop](https://jansauermann.github.io/educworkshop_2027.html), which takes place at Uppsala University on May 11, 2027. The keynote presentation will be held by **Susan Dynarski (Harvard)**. Starting December 1, 2026, you can submit your paper to the workshop.

I will be serving as a guest reviewer for the **2027 Colloquium on Personnel Economics**, to be held on March 18/19 at Waseda University in Tokyo. Please consider submitting your paper by [following this link](https://personneleconomics.eu/cope2027/).

You can now submit your paper to the [8th Stockholm Uppsala Education Economics Workshop](https://jansauermann.github.io/educworkshop_2026.html), which takes place on May 6, 2026. The keynote presentation will be held by **Kirabo Jackson (Northwestern)**.
I have been invited to join [ROCKWOOL Foundation Berlin (RF Berlin)](https://www.rfberlin.com/author/jansauermann/) as a Research Fellow.

My paper “The effects of increasing compensatory resource allocation on student achievement” is now published as an IFAU Working Paper [here](https://www.ifau.se/), or read the [Swedish-language report here](https://jansauermann.github.io/research.html#research-reports-and-other-publications).
